and , , ,

● Troop soldier (Dong Zhuo army): Zaku face × 1
● Jade Seal × 1

● Bushoza × 2
● 12 combined giant weapons (12 types of weapons) x 1 set

● LEGENDBB Strike Liu Bei Gundam Meditation Attire (Deactive Color) × 1
*"LEGENDBB Strike Liu Bei Gundam meditation mode (deactive color)"
